infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Questbound needs your location to track your adventures and verify quest completion.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Questbound needs your location to track your runs even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Questbound needs camera access to record quest completion videos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Questbound needs microphone access to record audio with quest videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Questbound needs photo library access to save and select quest videos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Questbound to use your location to track adventures.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Questbound to access your camera for quest videos.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Questbound to access your microphone for quest videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Questbound to access your photos for quest submissions.
